cohort: Women giving birth in the Metro East health district, Western Cape Province, South Africa between November 2014 and November 2015
finding: HIV, pre-eclampsia, cesarean section, and chronic hypertension were significantly associated with increased odds of experiencing a severe maternal outcome.
mod_finding: Birth by cesarean section was associated with an increased odds of severe maternal outcome (aOR 8.4; 95% CI 5.8-12.3).
